commands.name: Firmware Integrity Verification
commands.cmd: python %HIVE_ROOT%\NEURAL\brain\agents.py zorg "Verify firmware signatures against vendor keys. Check for unauthorized modifications in flash regions. Report any unsigned or altered firmware components. Recommend re-flashing with verified vendor images if anomalies found."
commands.why: UEFI/BIOS firmware is a critical attack surface; compromised firmware enables persistent, OS-independent threats undetected by software security tools.

commands.name: Memory Hardening Enforcement
commands.cmd: python %HIVE_ROOT%\NEURAL\brain\agents.py zorg "Check status of CPU memory protection features (NX, ASLR, CET, SMAP, SMEP). Validate kernel boot parameters enforce these. Report any disabled or misconfigured protections. Suggest kernel hardening adjustments if needed."
commands.why: Memory corruption exploits (buffer overflows, use-after-free) remain prevalent attack vectors. Hardware-enforced memory protections (ASLR, DEP, CET, SMAP, SMEP) must be actively validated and enforced.

commands.name: Binary Provenance Validation
commands.cmd: python %HIVE_ROOT%\NEURAL\brain\agents.py zorg "Verify PGP signatures and SHA256 hashes of core system binaries (kernel, init, key utilities) against trusted offline roots. Report any unsigned or mismatched binaries. Recommend quarantine and re-verification from known-good sources."
commands.why: Compromised build systems or tainted dependencies can introduce backdoors. Validating cryptographic signatures and hashes of critical binaries prevents supply chain attacks.

commands.name: Runtime Anomaly Detection
commands.cmd: python %HIVE_ROOT%\NEURAL\brain\agents.py zorg "Activate and audit eBPF-based syscall monitoring for anomalous patterns (e.g., unusual process injection, abnormal syscall sequences). Report deviations from established baselines. Suggest tuning rules to reduce false positives while maintaining detection fidelity."
commands.why: Zero-day exploits and fileless malware evade signature-based detection. Behavioral monitoring of syscalls, process trees, and memory anomalies provides essential runtime protection.

commands.name: Air-Gap Boundary Validation
commands.cmd: python %HIVE_ROOT%\NEURAL\brain\agents.py zorg "Scan for unauthorized wireless devices (Bluetooth, WiFi, NFC). Check for physical USB/Thunderbolt port enablement via BIOS. Validate no network interfaces are active. Report any potential air-gap violations. Recommend physical port disabling and RF shielding checks."
commands.why: Air-gapped systems are only secure if all physical and logical bridges are eliminated. Hidden channels (USB, audio, electromagnetic) can breach isolation.
